content: If the AUTOSAR COM module receives signals via large I - PDUs and these signals have features configured that need to keep the old value in certain cases, the A U TOSAR COM module shall correctly provide the old value for signals received via a large I - PDU in the same way as for signals received via normal I - PDUs.
